data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005's claim of rational methodological choice INHERITS the burden of proof from SRC_002's accusation of smuggled induction; if SRC_002 holds, SRC_005's 'rationality' is merely disguised irrationality. Kind: Inheritance (of burden). REFUTED IF: Verisimilitude can be formally defined and measured without any reference to the probability of future success, thus severing the link to inductive assumptions.
